authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Shumashti aste-m and Ningalam wōst, explaining the latter initial w as extension from wōr belly to body-part names. Grangali/Shumashti ast retains st with loss of h; the bare source stems require no possessive component.
